lines.trans: Has the reply on the All-Star project still not come through?
I have already chased them; right now their entire management team is consumed with signing Xin Huimei.
Every contact I know over there actually has zero time to deal with me.
They have signed plenty of big stars before—does it really warrant all this?
This time, crowdfunding to set up a foundation has thoroughly rattled the whole industry.
Over a single agency contract, their entire team of lawyers is grinding away nonstop.
With all those staff, they cannot even free up one lawyer to draft our contract.
Everywhere we turn, she seems to be right in our path.
Right now all we can do is wait.
Waiting with an awkward yet polite smile.
